policyDefinitions.description: Always Call; exact SMART_BASELINE Hit/Stand and Raise/Pass functions.

Frozen: never Fold when opponent is at target minus one, on soft hands, hard <=12 or hard 17+. Fold hard 13-16 only against visible 10-value or Ace; otherwise Call. Exact SMART_BASELINE Hit/Stand and Raise/Pass.

opponentDefinitions.description: Production basic Hit below 17. Always Raise when first; always Call.
Hit hard totals below 18 and soft totals below 19. Raise with probability .70 on 17+, .40 on hard 12–16, .55 otherwise. Call .70 on hard 12–14, .90 otherwise.

Untuned heuristic: Hit soft <19, hard <17, except Stand hard 16 versus visible 2–6 unless trailing by 3+. Raise 19+ always, 18 at .65, 17 at .35, otherwise .08 (.15 trailing by 3+, zero when ahead and one point from target). Call 15+, soft hands or <=11; hard 12–14 Call .65 against 7+ upcard, .80 otherwise. Always Call if folding would end the match.
Hit hard totals below 16 and soft totals below 18. Raise on 19+. Fold hard 12–14; Call other hands.
Start at SMART Raise probability. After >=3 observed responses to own Raises, multiply probability by .35 when observed Call fraction >=.75; otherwise unchanged.
Start at SMART Raise probability. After >=3 observed responses, add min(.40, 2 * observed Fold fraction), clamped to [0,1].

Known-policy test: if own public first card is 10-value/A, own opening is weak hard 12-16 and opponent score <6, Raise with max(SMART probability,.85). Otherwise SMART probability. Never reads opponent hidden total; unknown Fold-window eligibility remains uncertain.

SMART probability plus .60*smoothedFoldRate - .12*smoothedCallRate, plus .05 if trailing by 2+, minus .05 if leading by 2+. Rates use Beta(1,3): Fold=(folds+1)/(responses+4). Clamp [0,1]. Public response history updates gradually.
Diagnostic control for EXPLOIT_FOLD: identical SMART Hit/Stand, always Call, normal SMART Raise probability without the known-window bluff boost.

adaptation: Fresh history per match and seat; counts only publicly observed opponent Call/Fold responses to own Raises. EXPLOIT_FOLD knows the frozen response rule but never its current hidden hand. All four adaptive bots share SMART Hit/Stand and always Call.
seedIndependence: All realized match-seed cohorts checked disjoint from each other and from prior ablation/balance cohorts.
